headline: Ten degrees under a half-covered sky.
body: The temperature has settled at ten degrees. A west-southwest breeze holds near six kilometres an hour; pressure stands at one thousand twenty-eight and remains steady. Cloud covers half the sky, and the streets stay dry under the lamps.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: partly cloudy, 10°C, WSW 6 km/h, pressure 1028 steady

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: nearly three hours before civil dawn
